title: claude-settings check: silent-undo skips the cloud session-URL line at a PR body's end
why: lint/check_silent_undo.py `last_paragraph` (claude-settings e0b9696) skips a closing paragraph that is only the Claude Code attribution line or the posting footer. A cloud session's PR body ends with the attribution line and then a claude.ai/code/session_ URL paragraph, so that URL counts as the last paragraph and a Retire-run or Drops-lines line above it is not read.
note: Feedback for claude-settings, which the owner carries (sessions never edit claude-settings). Proposed fix: also skip a closing paragraph that is a lone https://claude.ai/code/session_ URL. Until then, a cloud PR body puts the session URL above its key lines. Reported by the batch runner after batch PR 270, 2026-11-09 03:20 CST; checked against the code.
